parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array, no `structural_evidence` fields (all null), and no `fields_or_signature` data for either `MetalWallpaperView` or `MetalWallpaperRenderer`. Without concrete evidence of shared members, overlapping field lists, or a measurable Jaccard similarity, there is no grounded basis on which to recommend a structural change. `MetalWallpaperView` and `MetalWallpaperRenderer` are architecturally distinct roles in a Metal rendering pipeline — a view and its backing renderer — whose co-location in the same `Renderers/` directory is expected, not coincidental duplication warranting extraction.
